::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's only advanced 3D NAND producer at national/global scale — founded by Tsinghua Unigroup with $24B in state-linked investment, YMTC reached 128-layer 3D NAND with its own Xtacking architecture before being added to the US Entity List.
:::

**Chinese name:** 长江存储 (Chángjiāng Cúnchǔ)

## What does this facility make?

3D NAND flash memory chips using XTacking wafer-bonding architecture, plus packaged memory chips and SSDs.

## Why does it matter?

The clearest case of a Chinese chipmaker reaching a genuinely globally competitive memory technology (Xtacking) before US export controls specifically targeted it — a 2023 finding that YMTC chips were inside a Huawei phone helped trigger tighter memory-sector controls.

## Technology Node Trajectory

- **2017**: 32-layer 3D NAND
- **2020**: 128-layer 3D NAND (Xtacking 2.0)

## Project Timeline

- **26 Jul 2016** — YMTC founded by Tsinghua Unigroup with Hubei provincial and Big Fund backing, $24 billion planned investment
- **01 Apr 2020** — YMTC introduces 128-layer 3D NAND using Xtacking 2.0 architecture
- **15 Dec 2022** — Added to the US Commerce Department's Entity List
